name: Absa
evidence: Absa Group describes itself as a leading pan-African bank; its South African bank offers retail, business, wealth, corporate and investment banking and insurance. Listed on the JSE (ABG).

name: Standard Bank
evidence: Standard Bank Group is an Africa-focused bank and financial services group, offering personal, business, corporate and investment banking across 21 African countries.

name: FNB
evidence: First National Bank (FNB) is a division of FirstRand Bank Limited and part of the FirstRand group; it provides retail and commercial banking and financial services in South Africa.

name: Nedbank
evidence: Nedbank Group describes itself as one of the largest financial services groups in Africa, offering wholesale and retail banking plus insurance, asset and wealth management.

name: Capitec
evidence: Capitec Bank, registered with the SA Reserve Bank and listed on the JSE, provides simplified personal and business banking to over 24 million clients.

name: Old Mutual
evidence: Old Mutual Limited is a pan-African financial services group, established as South Africa's first mutual life insurance company, offering life assurance, savings, short-term insurance, investments and asset management.

name: Sanlam
evidence: Sanlam describes itself as the largest insurer in Africa and an integrated financial services group, with life insurance, long-term savings, investment and (via Santam) short-term insurance.

name: Discovery
evidence: Discovery Limited is a South African financial services organisation; Discovery Health is the country's largest medical scheme administrator and the group also operates life, short-term and long-term insurance, savings and banking (Discovery Bank).

name: Momentum Group
evidence: Momentum Group Limited is a South African JSE-listed financial services group and one of the country's largest life insurers, operating retail and specialist brands including Momentum, Metropolitan, Guardrisk and Eris Properties. Previously named Momentum Metropolitan Holdings.

name: Investec
evidence: Investec is an international specialist bank and wealth manager; its Investment Banking division advises and raises capital for corporates, governments and institutional investors, and it runs business and commercial banking for mid-sized firms.

name: Vodacom
evidence: Vodacom Group describes itself as a leading African connectivity, digital and financial services company and a mobile network operator, majority-owned by Vodafone.

name: MTN
evidence: MTN Group describes itself as Africa's largest mobile network operator, providing voice, data, digital and fintech services across African markets.
